observations: Photo 0 shows a grey chest freezer with the brand name 'POLYSTAR' visible on the front left side.
The model number 'PV-CF 295LGR' is printed on the front right side of the freezer in photo 0.
There is a sticker with a fruit/vegetable image and a 'POLYSTAR' badge on the front, partially peeled.
The freezer has a white plastic latch on the lid and shows some surface wear and minor dents.
Photo 1 shows the interior of the freezer with two wire baskets, one white and one with blue accents.
The interior walls are frosted with ice buildup, indicating it has been used and possibly not defrosted recently.
The freezer appears to be in a room with tiled flooring and a curtain in the background.

claims.evidence: The model number 'PV-CF 295LGR' in photo 0 indicates a 295L capacity, not 210L.
No photo or video shows the freezer in operation; interior frost suggests it has been used, but functionality is not proven.

risks.risk: The freezer may not be working or may have compressor issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the freezer running with the compressor humming and temperature display (if any) or a photo of the power cord plugged in and the unit lit up.

risks.risk: Excessive frost buildup may indicate defrosting problems or poor insulation.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the interior showing the thickness of frost and any signs of water leakage or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having poor insulation or defrosting issues

risks.risk: The freezer may have structural damage or dents affecting its seal or performance.
risks.proof: A full 360-degree photo or video showing all sides, especially the lid seal and hinges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having cosmetic damage that may affect function

proof_requests: Video of the freezer running with the compressor on.
Close-up of the interior frost and any signs of damage or water.
Full 360-degree photo or video of the exterior, including lid seal and hinges.
response.reason: The model number contradicts the claimed capacity, and the working condition is unverified. The interior frost suggests use but not functionality. Proof of operation and condition is needed before pricing.
